evidence.quote: In e-skin or e-wear applications, the commonly used substrates usually suffer from instability, low toughness, or high notch sensitivity, which significantly reduces their service life. For example, typical PDMS (Sylgard 184) can be broken at 200% strain, polyurethane at 700% strain, and styrene butadiene styrene block copolymer (saturated) breaks at 280% strain⁴.
evidence.locator: Results / Rheological and mechanical properties, paragraph 15
